limitations: Validated means an out-of-sample evaluation was executed, not that performance is production-ready or profitable.
No injury, confirmed-lineup, weather, receiver/line personnel, pressure, EPA, or timestamped historical market feeds are implemented.
Opponent-adjusted rolling points are coarse matchup features; scoring residual distributions do not model NFL key numbers, heteroscedasticity, or discrete score mechanics.
No verified historical market lines: spread, total, and QB prop hit rates are unavailable; regression error is reported instead.
QB evaluation is conditional on a recorded appearance, includes substitutes, and omits inactive/DNP quarterbacks; it is not a validated starter-or-void model.
QB forecasts require an explicitly verified starting quarterback, prior appearances, and opponent history. Unconfirmed/replacement starters are unavailable.
The complete 2025 holdout is evaluated only by the frozen recipe and never used for calibration or fitting; saved results are reused by default.
Validation/current input features assume game statistics available six hours after scheduled kickoff; exact source publication timestamps are not provided.
Forecast uncertainty is an empirical predictive interval, not uncertainty that a model-market difference is a profitable edge.
